observed_repository_state.content_pipeline: Registry metadata and validators only; no controlled batch worker/queue executor or durable per-lesson production/QA event store.

required_before_open.acceptance: A reviewed, bounded Batch 01 mechanism selects only the 12 IDs, checks gates and current snapshot again immediately before enqueue, blocks re-production without versioned rework, and can be disabled without deleting history.
Each actual production and QA transition has a durable versioned reference and evidence; do not report postproduction Practice readiness until produced anchors and audio are validated.
Recheck reserved purposes/production state and copyright/rights, use existing approval policy before any significant content publication or production mutation.

next_action.requires: Queue foundation validates closed state and rejects unauthorized opening; repeat opening review using fresh reserved/production snapshot and verified rights/authority before a separate reviewed activation. No background worker or public publication is implied.
